source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the chapter 13 exercise solved (PDF 15-17, printed 12-14), with the printed numerical answers checked.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 13 (Thermal Physics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain; numerical problems qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai, aur jahan kitab mein ghalti hai wahan "Kitab ki ghalti" box hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Choose the correct answer: (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
13.1 Which condition is necessary for most gases to behave nearly ideally?
(Kis haalat mein aksar gases taqreeban ideal gas ki tarah behave karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kam pressure par molecules door door hote hain, is liye un ka apna volume na hone ke barabar hota hai; zyada temperature par un ki kinetic energy bari hoti hai, is liye un ke darmiyan forces (kashish) ka asar na hone ke barabar hota hai. Yehi ideal gas ke kinetic theory wale mafroozay (assumptions) hain.

blocks.prompt:
13.2 vᵣₘₛ of the gas molecule is 300 m s⁻¹. If its absolute temperature is reduced to half and molecular weight is doubled, then vᵣₘₛ will become:
(Gas molecule ki vᵣₘₛ 300 m s⁻¹ hai. Agar absolute temperature aadha aur molecular weight dugna kar diya jaye to vᵣₘₛ kitni ho jaye gi?)

13.3 The rms speed of the gas at 27 °C is v. If temperature of the gas is raised to 327 °C, the rms speed of the gas is:
(27 °C par gas ki rms speed v hai. Agar temperature 327 °C kar diya jaye to rms speed kitni ho gi?)
blocks.explanation: vᵣₘₛ ∝ √T (T kelvin mein). T₁ = 27 + 273 = 300 K, T₂ = 327 + 273 = 600 K. v₂ = v √(600/300) = v√2. (Options yahan a–d likhe gaye hain; neeche note dekhein.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chaar options ke label (a), (b), (b), (c) chhape hain: (a) v, (b) v/√2, (b) v√2, (c) 3v. Yahan in ko (a)–(d) likha gaya hai; sahi jawab v√2 hai jo kitab mein doosra "(b)" hai, aur yahan (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
13.4 Ratio of the rms velocities of O₂ and H₂ at equal temperature will be:
(Barabar temperature par O₂ aur H₂ ki rms velocities ki nisbat (ratio) kya ho gi?)
blocks.explanation: Ek hi T par vᵣₘₛ ∝ 1/√M. v(O₂)/v(H₂) = √(M(H₂)/M(O₂)) = √(2/32) = √(1/16) = 1/4, yani 1:4. Halki gas (H₂) tez chalti hai.

blocks.prompt:
13.5 In a closed room, there is a gas with pressure of 3.2 × 10⁵ N m⁻². If the gas density is 6 kg m⁻³, what is the effective speed of each gas particle?
(Band kamre mein gas ka pressure 3.2 × 10⁵ N m⁻² aur density 6 kg m⁻³ hai. Har gas particle ki effective (rms) speed kya hai?)

13.6 Which statement is not the statement of kinetic theory of gases?
(Kaun sa bayan kinetic theory of gases ka bayan NAHIN hai?)

options.text: Molecules sirf takkar (collision) ke dauran ek doosre par asar daalte hain
Molecules musalsal be-tarteeb (random) harkat mein hain
Takkar bohat thore waqt ki hoti hai
Molecules chhote sakht gole hain jo inelastic takkarein karte hain

blocks.explanation: Kinetic theory maanti hai ke molecules ki aapas mein aur deewaron se takkarein perfectly elastic hoti hain (kinetic energy zaya nahin hoti). Inelastic takkar is theory ka hissa nahin.

blocks.prompt:
13.7 Which equation ensures that a star remains stable against gravitational collapse?
(Kaun si equation yaqeeni banati hai ke sitara gravity se sukar kar gir (collapse) na jaye?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrostatic equation ΔP/Δr = −GMᵣρᵣ/r² andar ki taraf gravity aur bahar ki taraf pressure ko barabar (balance) karti hai, is liye sitara na girta hai na be-hadd phailta hai (13.6).

blocks.prompt:
13.8 What happens to a star when its gravitational force becomes greater than its internal pressure?
(Jab sitaray ki gravitational force us ke andaruni pressure se zyada ho jaye to kya hota hai?)

options.text: Sitara phail kar red giant ban jata hai
Sitara sukarta hai aur us ke core ka temperature barhta hai
Sitara bina tabdeeli ke stable rehta hai
Nuclear fusion foran ruk jata hai

blocks.explanation: Jab gravity jeet jaye to sitara sukarta (contract) hai; gas dabti hai, is ki density aur particles ki kinetic energy barhti hai aur core ka temperature barh jata hai (Examples 13.3 aur 13.4).

blocks.text: Short Answer Questions (mukhtasar sawalat)

blocks.prompt:
13.1 Do all gases have the same kinetic energy at the same temperature? If yes, give example.
(Kya ek hi temperature par tamam gases ki kinetic energy barabar hoti hai? Agar haan to misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Har molecule ki average translational K.E., <K.E.> = (3/2)k_BT, sirf temperature par munhasir (depend) hai, gas ki qisam ya mass par nahin.
Misaal: 300 K par O₂ aur H₂ dono ke molecules ki <K.E.> = 1.5 × 1.38 × 10⁻²³ × 300 = 6.21 × 10⁻²¹ J hai; halki H₂ bas tez (4 guna) chalti hai.

blocks.prompt:
13.2 A vessel is fitted with a mixture of two different gases. Will the mean kinetic energy per molecule of gases be equal? Explain briefly.
(Ek bartan mein do mukhtalif gases ka mixture hai. Kya dono gases ke har molecule ki mean kinetic energy barabar ho gi? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Haan. Mixture mein dono gases ek hi temperature par hoti hain (thermal equilibrium), aur har molecule ki mean K.E. = (3/2)k_BT sirf T par munhasir hai. Is liye dono ki barabar hai; sirf rms speeds mukhtalif hain (halki gas tez chalti hai).

blocks.prompt:
13.3 If density of a gas is doubled, keeping all other factors unchanged, what will be the effect on the pressure of the gas?
(Agar baqi sab cheezein wohi rehte hue gas ki density dugni kar di jaye to pressure par kya asar ho ga?)
blocks.explanation:
P = ⅓ρ<v²>. <v²> wohi rahe (temperature wohi) to P ∝ ρ.
Is liye density dugni karne se pressure bhi dugna ho jata hai: har unit volume mein zyada molecules deewaron se takrate hain.

blocks.prompt:
13.4 A gas enclosed in a container is heated up. What is the effect of pressure on gas molecules?
(Band bartan mein gas ko garam kiya jaye to pressure aur gas molecules par kya asar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Garam karne se temperature barhta hai, is liye molecules ki average K.E. ((3/2)k_BT) aur speed barhti hai.
Woh deewaron se zyada baar aur zyada momentum ki tabdeeli ke saath takrate hain, is liye deewaron par force aur pressure barh jata hai (constant volume par P ∝ T).

blocks.prompt:
13.5 The number of molecules of a gas in a container is doubled. What will be the effect on the rms speed?
(Bartan mein gas ke molecules ki tadaad dugni kar di jaye to rms speed par kya asar ho ga?)
blocks.explanation: Koi asar nahin. vᵣₘₛ = √(3k_BT/m) sirf temperature aur ek molecule ke mass par munhasir hai, molecules ki tadaad par nahin. (Same temperature par N dugna karne se pressure dugna ho ga, lekin vᵣₘₛ wohi rahe gi.)

blocks.prompt:
13.6 Explain briefly, why it is not possible to increase the temperature of the gas while keeping its volume and pressure constant.
(Mukhtasar batayein ke volume aur pressure constant rakh kar gas ka temperature barhana kyun mumkin nahin.)
blocks.explanation:
Gas ki muqarrara miqdar ke liye PV = Nk_BT, is liye T = PV/(Nk_B). Agar P aur V constant hon to T bhi fixed hai.
Asal mein zyada temperature ka matlab tez molecules hain jo deewaron se zyada zor aur zyada baar takrate hain; is se pressure barhta hai jab tak volume ko barhne na diya jaye.

blocks.prompt:
13.7 On reducing the volume of a gas at constant temperature, the pressure of the gas increases. Explain briefly on the basis of kinetic theory of gases.
(Constant temperature par gas ka volume kam karne se pressure barhta hai. Kinetic theory ki buniyad par mukhtasar wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Constant temperature par molecules ki average K.E. aur speed nahin badalti.
Chhote volume mein har unit volume mein zyada molecules hote hain (N/V zyada) aur deewaron ke darmiyan kam faasla tay karte hain, is liye har unit area se zyada baar takrate hain.
Fi second zyada takkarein = fi unit area zyada force: P = ⅓(N/V)m<v²> barh jata hai (Boyle's law).

blocks.prompt:
13.8 How does the balance between gravitational force and internal pressure determine whether a start expands or contracts during its evolution?
(Gravitational force aur andaruni pressure ka balance kaise tay karta hai ke sitara apne irtiqa (evolution) mein phailega ya sukrega?)
blocks.explanation:
Gravity sitaray ki gas ko andar kheenchti hai; andaruni (gas ka) pressure bahar dhakelta hai.
Dono barabar: hydrostatic equilibrium (tawazun), sitara stable hai.
Gravity > andaruni pressure: sitara sukarta (contract) hai aur core ziyada ghana (dense) aur garam hota hai.
Andaruni pressure > gravity: sitara phailta (expand) hai (maslan red giant ban jata hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "a start" chhapa hai; matlab "a star" (sitara) hai.
Constructed Response Questions (wazahati sawalat)

blocks.prompt:
13.1 What will be the kinetic energy near absolute zero? Explain.
(Absolute zero ke qareeb kinetic energy kya ho gi? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Molecules ki average translational K.E. = (3/2)k_BT hai, yani yeh absolute temperature ke seedha mutanasib (directly proportional) hai.
Jab T → 0 K, to <K.E.> → 0: molecules taqreeban harkat band kar dete hain, deewaron se mushkil se takrate hain aur gas ka pressure bhi taqreeban zero ho jata hai.
Amal mein har asal gas absolute zero tak pohanchne se pehle liquid ya solid ban jati hai, aur quantum physics ke mutabiq bohat thori minimum (zero-point) energy baqi rehti hai (chapter se bahar).

blocks.prompt:
13.2 What is the average kinetic energy of the oxygen and nitrogen molecules in a room at room temperature?
(Kamre ke temperature par kamre mein oxygen aur nitrogen molecules ki average kinetic energy kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Dono gases ka temperature ek hai, is liye dono ke har molecule ki average K.E. barabar hai:
<K.E.> = (3/2)k_BT
Kamre ka temperature T = 300 K:
<K.E.> = 1.5 × (1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹) × 300 K = 6.21 × 10⁻²¹ J (taqreeban 0.039 eV)
K.E. barabar hai lekin rms speeds mukhtalif hain: halki N₂ (28 u), O₂ (32 u) se tez chalti hai, 25 °C par taqreeban 515 m s⁻¹ aur 481 m s⁻¹ (Example 13.2).

blocks.prompt:
13.3 Consider a gas enclosed in a sealed container. By what factor does the gas temperature change if: (a) the volume and pressure are both doubled? (b) the volume is halved and the pressure is tripled?
(Band bartan mein gas hai. Temperature kitne guna badlega agar: (a) volume aur pressure dono dugne kar diye jayein? (b) volume aadha aur pressure teen guna kar diya jaye?)
blocks.explanation:
Band bartan mein N fixed hai, is liye PV = Nk_BT se T ∝ PV, yani T₂/T₁ = (P₂V₂)/(P₁V₁).
(a) T₂/T₁ = (2P)(2V)/(PV) = 4: temperature 4 guna ho jata hai.
(b) T₂/T₁ = (3P)(V/2)/(PV) = 3/2: temperature 1.5 guna ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Temperature hamesha kelvin (absolute) mein lein. "4 guna" ka matlab hai 300 K se 1200 K, na ke 27 °C se 108 °C.

blocks.prompt:
13.4 Is it possible to boil water at room temperature without heating? Explain.
(Kya baghair garam kiye kamre ke temperature par paani ubala ja sakta hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Paani tab ubalta hai jab us ka vapour pressure (bhaap ka dabao) upar ke pressure ke barabar ho jaye. Kamre ke temperature par molecules ki speeds mukhtalif hoti hain; sab se tez molecules surface se nikal jate hain aur thora sa vapour pressure banta hai (25 °C par taqreeban 3 kPa).
Agar paani ke upar se hawa nikal di jaye (maslan bell jar aur vacuum pump se) yahan tak ke pressure is value tak gir jaye, to poore paani mein bhaap ke bulbulay bante hain aur paani baghair garam kiye kamre ke temperature par ubalne lagta hai.
Tez molecules nikalne se baqi molecules ki average K.E. kam hoti hai, is liye paani thanda bhi ho jata hai. (Boiling point aur vapour pressure chapter se thora bahar hain.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Pahar par pressure kam hota hai, is liye wahan paani 100 °C se kam par ubal jata hai. Yehi asool yahan hai: pressure kam karo to boiling point (ubalne ka darja) kam ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
13.5 Explain how the drop of ink in a beaker containing water will behave.
(Paani wale beaker mein siyahi (ink) ka qatra kaise behave karega? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ink ka qatra khud ba khud aahista aahista phailta hai yahan tak ke saare paani ka rang ek jaisa ho jata hai; isay diffusion (phailao) kehte hain.
Wajah (kinetic theory / Brownian motion): paani ke molecules musalsal random harkat mein hain aur har taraf se ink ke particles se takrate rehte hain, is liye ink ke particles tedhi meydhi (zig-zag) raahon par chalte hain.
Nateeja: ink zyada concentration (ghanapan) wali jagah se kam concentration wali jagah ki taraf jati hai. Garam paani mein molecules tez hote hain, is liye ink jaldi phailti hai.

blocks.text: Comprehensive Questions (tafseeli sawalat)

blocks.prompt:
13.1 Derive the expression of pressure exerted by the gas on the walls of the container.
(Bartan ki deewaron par gas ke pressure ka formula derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ek cube (mukaab) numa box lein jis ki har side L hai (volume V = L³) aur us mein N molecules hain, har ek ka mass m. Kinetic theory ke mafroozay maanein: molecules random harkat mein, elastic takkarein, takkar ke ilawa koi force nahin.
1. Ek takkar mein momentum ki tabdeeli: molecule x-direction mein vₓ se deewar se takra kar −vₓ se wapas aata hai.
Δp = −mvₓ − (mvₓ) = −2mvₓ
Deewar ko +2mvₓ momentum milta hai.
2. Usi deewar se do takkaron ka darmiyani waqt: molecule 2L faasla tay karta hai (saamne wali deewar tak aur wapas), is liye Δt = 2L/vₓ.
3. Ek molecule ki force (Newton ka doosra qanoon):
F = |Δp|/Δt = 2mvₓ/(2L/vₓ) = mvₓ²/L
4. Ek molecule ka pressure: P = F/L² = mvₓ²/L³ = mvₓ²/V
5. Tamam N molecules:
P = (m/V)(v₁ₓ² + v₂ₓ² + … + v_Nₓ²) = (Nm/V)<vₓ²>
jahan <vₓ²> x-direction mein velocity ke square ka average hai (pehle square karte hain kyun ke vₓ ka seedha average zero hota hai).
6. Random harkat: <v²> = <vₓ²> + <v_y²> + <v_z²> = 3<vₓ²>, is liye <vₓ²> = <v²>/3.
7. Lehaza
P = (1/3)(N/V)m<v²>  ya  PV = (1/3)Nm<v²>
8. Density ρ = Nm/V ke hawale se:
P = (1/3)ρ<v²>
9. Kinetic energy ke hawale se: P = (2/3)(N/V)<½mv²> = (2/3)N₀<K.E.>, jahan N₀ = N/V fi unit volume molecules ki tadaad hai.
Yani gas ka pressure fi unit volume molecules ki tadaad aur un ki average translational kinetic energy ke mutanasib hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: kitab Eq. 13.14 mein "PV = ⅓ρ<v²>" chhapti hai; sahi P = ⅓ρ<v²> hai, kyun ke ρ mein volume pehle hi shamil hai.

blocks.prompt:
13.2 Write the expression for rms speed, and most probable speed of a gas molecule.
(Gas molecule ki rms speed aur most probable speed ke formulas likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
rms speed: molecules ki speeds ke squares ke average ka square root.
vᵣₘₛ = √<v²> = √(3k_BT/m) = √(3RT/M) = √(3P/ρ)
jahan k_B Boltzmann constant, m ek molecule ka mass, R gas constant, M molar mass (kg mol⁻¹), P pressure aur ρ density hai.
Most probable speed (chapter se bahar): woh speed jo sab se zyada molecules ki hoti hai, yani Maxwell speed distribution ke graph ki choti (peak) wali speed.
vₘₚ = √(2k_BT/m) = √(2RT/M)
Dono √(T/m) ke mutanasib hain; vₘₚ chhoti hai: vₘₚ : vᵣₘₛ = √2 : √3 ≈ 1 : 1.22.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab is chapter mein sirf vᵣₘₛ derive karti hai; most probable speed ka formula kitab mein nahin, is liye isay chapter se bahar likha gaya hai. Farq yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: rms mein 3, most probable mein 2.

blocks.prompt:
13.3 Explain the Boltzmann distributions law on the basis of statistical physics.
(Statistical physics ki buniyad par Boltzmann distribution law ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Statistical physics probability (imkaan) ke zariye bohat zyada molecules ko bayan karti hai. Molecules ki speeds mukhtalif hoti hain, is liye woh mukhtalif energy states (levels) E₁, E₂, E₃, … mein hote hain.
Boltzmann distribution law: kisi energy state mein molecules ki tadaad (population) us ki energy barhne ke saath exponentially kam hoti hai. Do levels ke liye:
N₂/N₁ = e^(−ΔE/k_BT)
jahan N₁ aur N₂ neeche aur upar wali states ki population hain, ΔE = E₂ − E₁, k_B Boltzmann constant aur T absolute temperature hai. e^(−ΔE/k_BT) ko Boltzmann factor kehte hain.
Matlab:
1. ΔE > 0 hai, is liye N₂ < N₁: kam energy wali states mein zyada particles hote hain.
2. Kisi state mein molecule milne ka imkaan e^(−E/k_BT) ke mutabiq hai.
3. Kam T par (k_BT ≪ ΔE) taqreeban sab molecules sab se neechi state mein hote hain; T barhne se zyada molecules upar ki states mein jate hain aur N₂/N₁ 1 ke qareeb hota jata hai.
4. Har takkar molecule ki energy badalti hai, lekin T par average energy E_av = (3/2)k_BT hi rehti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misaal: seerhi ke neeche wale qadmon par zyada log khare hon aur upar wale qadmon par kam. Temperature barhao (zyada energy do) to upar wale qadmon par log barh jate hain, lekin neeche phir bhi zyada rehte hain.

blocks.prompt:
13.4 Describe the pressure role on the neutron star.
(Neutron star mein pressure ke kirdar ko bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Sitara tab tak stable hai jab tak andar ki taraf gravity ki kheench ko bahar ki taraf pressure barabar karta hai (hydrostatic equilibrium, ΔP/Δr = −GMᵣρᵣ/r²).
1. Banna: taqreeban das ya zyada solar mass wale sitaray mein fusion se iron ka be-amal (inert) core banta hai. Fuel khatam hone par thermal (gas ka) pressure gravity ko nahin rok pata; core gir (collapse) jata hai aur sitara supernova ki soorat mein phatta hai.
2. Collapse mein core itna dabta hai ke electrons protons se mil kar neutrons ban jate hain.
3. Collapse tab rukta hai jab maadda neutrons ki degenerate gas ban jata hai: is ka pressure (neutron degeneracy pressure, nuclear forces ke saath) temperature par munhasir nahin aur itna taqatwar ho jata hai ke bohat bari gravity ko barabar kar de. Ab core neutron star hai, taqreeban 20 km chaura (chapter se bahar).
4. Is balance ki wajah se neutron star intehai ghana (dense) hai: is ke maadday ke ek chamach ka mass 5.5 × 10¹² kg se zyada hai.
5. Collapse magnetic field lines ko bhi qareeb kar deta hai, is liye field bohat taqatwar ho jati hai; tezi se ghoomnay wale neutron stars radiation ki shuaaein (beams) chhorte hain (pulsars).
6. Agar baqi bacha mass bohat zyada ho (taqreeban 2–3 solar mass se zyada), to yeh pressure bhi gravity ko nahin rok pata aur core black hole ban jata hai (chapter se bahar).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aam gas ka pressure temperature se aata hai (garam = tez molecules). Neutron star ka pressure "degeneracy" se aata hai: neutrons ko itna qareeb nahin dabaya ja sakta, chahe sitara thanda ho jaye. Isi liye neutron star thanda ho kar bhi nahin girta.

blocks.prompt:
13.5 Show that temperature of a gas is a direct measure of the average translational K.E. of its molecules.
(Sabit karein ke gas ka temperature us ke molecules ki average translational K.E. ka seedha paimana hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Kinetic theory se V volume mein m mass wale N molecules ka pressure:
PV = (1/3)Nm<v²>   ...(1)
Ideal gas law se: PV = nRT = nN_Ak_BT = Nk_BT   ...(2)   (n = N/N_A, R = N_Ak_B)
(1) aur (2) ko barabar karein:
(1/3)Nm<v²> = Nk_BT
m<v²> = 3k_BT
Dono taraf 1/2 se zarb dein:
(1/2)m<v²> = (3/2)k_BT
<K.E.> = (3/2)k_BT
3/2 aur k_B constants hain, is liye <K.E.> ∝ T.
Lehaza gas ka absolute temperature us ke molecules ki average translational kinetic energy ka seedha paimana (direct measure) hai: T dugna to <K.E.> dugni, aur T = 0 K par <K.E.> = 0. Yeh gas ki qisam par munhasir nahin.

blocks.prompt:
13.6 Explain stellar evolution in terms of the balance between gravitational pressure and internal pressure, and how stellar mass determines whether a star ends as white dwarf, neutron star or black hole.
(Gravitational pressure aur andaruni pressure ke balance ke hawale se stellar evolution (sitaron ka irtiqa) bayan karein, aur batayein ke sitaray ka mass kaise tay karta hai ke woh white dwarf, neutron star ya black hole banega.)
blocks.explanation:
Poori zindagi sitaray mein gravity (andar kheenchti hai) aur andaruni pressure (bahar dhakelta hai) ka muqabla hota hai.
1. Nebula aur protostar: gas aur dhool ka badal (nebula) gravity se sukarta hai. Sukarne se is ki density aur temperature barhte hain (K.E. ∝ T) aur protostar banta hai.
2. Main-sequence sitara: jab core kaafi garam ho jaye to hydrogen fuse ho kar helium banti hai aur bohat energy nikalti hai. Ab gas aur radiation ka pressure gravity ko barabar karta hai (hydrostatic equilibrium, ΔP/Δr = −GMᵣρᵣ/r²) aur sitara zindagi ka zyada hissa stable rehta hai (Suraj abhi isi marhalay mein hai).
3. Red giant / red supergiant: core ki hydrogen khatam hone par core sukar kar garam hota hai aur bahar ki tahein phail jati hain (bahar wale hissay mein andaruni pressure > gravity). Kam az kam aadhay solar mass wale sitaray phir helium ko carbon aur oxygen mein fuse karte hain; bhaari sitaray iron tak bhaari elements banate jate hain.
4. Aakhri marhala, mass tay karta hai: fuel khatam hone par thermal pressure sitaray ko gravity ke khilaf nahin sambhal pata aur woh gir (collapse) jata hai.
- Kam aur darmiyanay mass wale sitaray (Suraj jaisay): bahar ki tahein planetary nebula ban kar nikal jati hain aur core sukar kar ghana white dwarf ban jata hai, jisay electron degeneracy pressure sambhalta hai (taqreeban 1.4 solar mass tak, chapter se bahar).
- Taqreeban das ya zyada solar mass wale sitaray: iron core girta hai aur sitara supernova ban kar phatta hai. Agar baqi bacha hissa taqreeban 2–3 solar mass tak ho to neutron degeneracy pressure collapse rok deta hai aur neutron star banta hai.
- Sab se bhaari sitaray: baqi bacha hissa itna bhaari hai ke koi pressure gravity ko nahin rok sakta; woh poora gir kar black hole ban jata hai.
Yani jitna zyada mass, utni taqatwar gravity aur utna ghana aakhri jism: white dwarf → neutron star → black hole. (1.4 aur 2–3 solar mass ki hadd chapter se bahar hai.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Ek line mein: gravity andar, pressure bahar. Jab tak fuel hai pressure jeet-ta ya barabar rehta hai; fuel khatam to gravity jeet-ti hai. Kitni door tak gravity jeet-ti hai, yeh mass tay karta hai.
Numerical Problems (hisabi sawalat)

blocks.prompt:
13.1 Calculate the rms velocity of hydrogen molecules at standard temperature and pressure (STP). Density of hydrogen at STP; ρ = 8.957 × 10⁻² kg m⁻³. Density of mercury = 13600 kg m⁻³, g = 9.8 m s⁻².
Ans: 1.84 × 10³ m s⁻¹
(STP par hydrogen molecules ki rms velocity maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Given (diya gaya): ρ(H₂) = 8.957 × 10⁻² kg m⁻³, ρ(Hg) = 13600 kg m⁻³, g = 9.8 m s⁻², STP par pressure 76 cm (h = 0.76 m) mercury column ka hota hai.
Required (maloom karna): vᵣₘₛ = ?
Qadam 1: STP par pressure
P = hρ(Hg)g = (0.76 m)(13600 kg m⁻³)(9.8 m s⁻²) = 1.013 × 10⁵ N m⁻²
Qadam 2: Formula
P = ⅓ρvᵣₘₛ²  ⇒  vᵣₘₛ = √(3P/ρ)
Qadam 3: Values daalein
vᵣₘₛ = √(3 × 1.013 × 10⁵ N m⁻² / 8.957 × 10⁻² kg m⁻³)
vᵣₘₛ = √(3.393 × 10⁶ m² s⁻²)
vᵣₘₛ = 1.84 × 10³ m s⁻¹
Jawab: vᵣₘₛ ≈ 1.84 × 10³ m s⁻¹ (kitab ke jawab ke mutabiq).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Mercury ki density aur g is liye diye gaye hain ke STP ka pressure (76 cm mercury) P = hρg se pascal mein nikala ja sake.

blocks.prompt:
13.2 Determine the pressure of oxygen gas at 0 °C if the density of oxygen is 1.44 kg m⁻³ at STP and rms speed at STP is 456.4 m s⁻¹.
Ans: 1.0 × 10⁵ N m⁻²
(0 °C par oxygen gas ka pressure maloom karein agar STP par oxygen ki density 1.44 kg m⁻³ aur rms speed 456.4 m s⁻¹ hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Given: ρ = 1.44 kg m⁻³, vᵣₘₛ = 456.4 m s⁻¹, T = 0 °C = 273 K
Required: P = ?
Formula: P = ⅓ρvᵣₘₛ²
Values daalein:
P = ⅓ × (1.44 kg m⁻³) × (456.4 m s⁻¹)²
P = 0.48 kg m⁻³ × 2.083 × 10⁵ m² s⁻²
P = 9.998 × 10⁴ N m⁻²
Jawab: P ≈ 1.0 × 10⁵ N m⁻² (kitab ke mutabiq).

blocks.prompt:
13.3 At what temperature will the rms speed of the molecules of gas be three times its value at STP?
Ans: 2184 °C
(Kis temperature par gas molecules ki rms speed STP wali value ki teen guna ho gi?)
blocks.explanation:
Given: T₁ = 0 °C = 273 K (STP), v₂ = 3v₁
Required: T₂ = ?
Formula: vᵣₘₛ = √(3k_BT/m), is liye vᵣₘₛ ∝ √T aur v₂/v₁ = √(T₂/T₁)
Values daalein:
3 = √(T₂/273 K)
9 = T₂/273 K
T₂ = 9 × 273 K = 2457 K
Celsius mein: T₂ = 2457 − 273 = 2184 °C
Jawab: T₂ = 2457 K = 2184 °C (kitab ke mutabiq).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Speed teen guna karni ho to temperature (kelvin mein) 3² = 9 guna karna parta hai, kyun ke speed √T ke mutanasib hai.

blocks.prompt:
13.4 If a gas is at temperature 80 °C and pressure 5 × 10⁻¹⁰ N m⁻², having 1 m³ volume, what is the number of molecules per cubic metre, where Boltzmann's constant is 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹.
Ans: 1.02 × 10¹¹ molecules
(Gas 80 °C par hai, pressure 5 × 10⁻¹⁰ N m⁻² aur volume 1 m³ hai. Fi cubic metre molecules ki tadaad kya hai? (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹))
blocks.explanation:
Given: T = 80 °C = 353 K, P = 5 × 10⁻¹⁰ N m⁻², V = 1 m³, k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹
Required: N/V = ?
Formula: PV = Nk_BT  ⇒  N/V = P/(k_BT)
Values daalein:
N/V = (5 × 10⁻¹⁰ N m⁻²) / (1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹ × 353 K)
N/V = (5 × 10⁻¹⁰) / (4.871 × 10⁻²¹) m⁻³
N/V = 1.03 × 10¹¹ m⁻³
Jawab: taqreeban 1.03 × 10¹¹ molecules fi cubic metre (1.026 × 10¹¹; kitab 1.02 × 10¹¹ chhapti hai, yeh wohi jawab neeche ki taraf round kiya gaya hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Itna kam pressure (5 × 10⁻¹⁰ N m⁻²) bohat achay vacuum (khala) jaisa hai, phir bhi har m³ mein 10¹¹ molecules hain. Is se pata chalta hai ke molecules kitne zyada hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
13.5 The temperature and pressure in the Sun's atmosphere are 2.00 × 10⁶ K and 0.0300 Pa respectively. Calculate the rms speed of free electrons (mass of the electron = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg).
Ans: 9.5 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹
(Suraj ki fiza (atmosphere) mein temperature 2.00 × 10⁶ K aur pressure 0.0300 Pa hai. Free electrons ki rms speed maloom karein (electron ka mass = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg).)
blocks.explanation:
Given: T = 2.00 × 10⁶ K, P = 0.0300 Pa, m = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg, k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹
Required: vᵣₘₛ = ?
Formula: vᵣₘₛ = √(3k_BT/m) (pressure ki zaroorat nahin: vᵣₘₛ sirf T aur m par munhasir hai)
Values daalein:
vᵣₘₛ = √(3 × 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹ × 2.00 × 10⁶ K / 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg)
vᵣₘₛ = √(8.28 × 10⁻¹⁷ / 9.11 × 10⁻³¹) m s⁻¹
vᵣₘₛ = √(9.09 × 10¹³ m² s⁻²)
vᵣₘₛ = 9.53 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹
Jawab: vᵣₘₛ ≈ 9.5 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ (kitab ke mutabiq).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Pressure (0.0300 Pa) sawal mein ek "faltu" (extra) value hai. Imtihan mein aisi value ko pehchanein aur sirf zaroori formula lagayein.

blocks.prompt:
13.6 A star has a mass enclosed within radius r equal to 2.0 × 10³⁰ kg, density 1500 kg m⁻³ and radius 7.0 × 10⁸ m. Calculate the gravitational force inside the star.
Ans: 2.94 × 10² N on mass m
(Sitaray ke radius r ke andar band mass 2.0 × 10³⁰ kg, density 1500 kg m⁻³ aur radius 7.0 × 10⁸ m hai. Sitaray ke andar gravitational force maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Given: Mᵣ = 2.0 × 10³⁰ kg, ρ = 1500 kg m⁻³, r = 7.0 × 10⁸ m, G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²
Required: radius r par mass m par gravitational force
Formula: sirf r ke andar wala mass, mass m ko markaz ki taraf kheenchta hai:
F = GMᵣm/r²
Values daalein:
F = (6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²)(2.0 × 10³⁰ kg) m / (7.0 × 10⁸ m)²
F = (1.334 × 10²⁰ / 4.9 × 10¹⁷) m N kg⁻¹
F = 2.72 × 10² m N
Jawab: F ≈ 2.7 × 10² N har kilogram mass m par (2.72 × 10² m N, markaz ki taraf).
Agar density se hal karein (Mᵣ = (4/3)πr³ρ, is liye F = (4/3)πGρrm):
F = (4/3)(3.14)(6.67 × 10⁻¹¹)(1500)(7.0 × 10⁸) m = 2.93 × 10² m N, jo kitab ka jawab hai.
Hydrostatic equation mein fi unit volume gravitational force GMᵣρ/r² = 2.72 × 10² × 1500 = 4.08 × 10⁵ N m⁻³ hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka jawab 2.94 × 10² N (mass m par) diye gaye band mass se nahin nikalta: Mᵣ = 2.0 × 10³⁰ kg ke saath GMᵣ/r² = 2.72 × 10² N fi kg aata hai. Kitab ki value density se aati hai, (4/3)πGρr ≈ 2.93 × 10² N fi kg; data aapas mein nahin milta kyun ke (4/3)πr³ρ = 2.16 × 10³⁰ kg hai, 2.0 × 10³⁰ kg nahin. Sawal mein diye gaye mass se F ≈ 2.72 × 10² m N hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: "N on mass m" ka matlab hai jawab m ke saath likha jata hai: agar m = 1 kg ho to force taqreeban 272 N hai. Imtihan mein dono tareeqay (mass se aur density se) dikha dein aur farq ki wajah likh dein.
